newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mandela congratulates Clinton.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mandela congratulates Clinton.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela sent a message of congratulations to Bill Clinton on his re-election, the Foreign Affairs department said in Pretoria.

"In his message President Mandela expressed the hope that relations between South Africa and the United States will continue to strengthen during President Clinton's second term of office," the department said in a statement on Wednesday.
The message was sent .."through the appropriate diplomatic channels", the statement said.

It added that the U.S.-South Africa Bi-national Commission, a body to improve ties between them, would meet in the first half of next year, with Deputy President Thabo Mbeki representing South Africa in the talks with Clinton's deputy, Al Gore.

Relations between the Pretoria and Washington governments have been strained several times over the past few years, particularly over South Africa's close ties and cooperation with Libya, Cuba and Iran.
